extracted text: The gel composition for [Ge]PLS-1 was 1.0 SiO2:x GeO2:0.30 TMAOH:5.0 H2O, where x was 0-0.1. Hydrothermal treatment was performed for 3 days at 170°C. The dehydrative condensation of [Ge]PLS-1 was performed at 500°C for 6 h (heating rate was 0.5°C/min) under air flow (100 mL/min) to afford the CDS-1 zeolite. TMAOH stands for tetramethylammonium hydroxide which was used as an organic structure-directing agent (OSDA).
property mapping:
Si: corresponds to SiO2 in the gel composition
Ge: corresponds to GeO2 in the gel composition
OH: part of TMAOH (tetramethylammonium hydroxide)
H2O: directly mentioned in the gel composition
osda_names: TMAOH (tetramethylammonium hydroxide)
osda_ratios: corresponds to the TMAOH value in the gel composition
crystallization_temperature: 170°C for [Ge]PLS-1 and 500°C for [Ge]CDS-1
crystallization_time: 3 days (72 hours) for [Ge]PLS-1 and 6 hours for [Ge]CDS-1
product_names: [Ge]PLS-1 for the layered precursor and [Ge]CDS-1 for the zeolite
formula abbreviations:
TMAOH: tetramethylammonium hydroxide, used as the organic structure-directing agent
H-kanemite: acidified form of Na-kanemite, used as silica source
PLS-1: Pentagonal Layered Silicate-1, the layered precursor
CDS-1: crystalline dioxysilicate-1, the zeolite product with CDO topology
ratio calculations:
For all recipes, Si is set to 1.0 as the base. Ge values are calculated from the Si/Ge ratios in the starting gel:
For Si/Ge = 25: Ge = 1.0/25 = 0.04
For Si/Ge = 50: Ge = 1.0/50 = 0.02
For Si/Ge = 100: Ge = 1.0/100 = 0.01
For Si/Ge = 200: Ge = 1.0/200 = 0.005
For pure silica: Ge = 0
TMAOH ratio is 0.30 relative to Si for all recipes
H2O ratio is 5.0 relative to Si for all recipes
